youtube_description:
Here's the opening to the past DVD release of Muppet Treasure Island DVD which was later replaced with Kermit's 50th Anniversary edition of this film in 3 years after the initial release on June 4, 2002:

1. Blue FBI Warning screens
2. 2001 Walt Disney Home Entertainment logo (Black background)
3. Main Menu screen
4. Bonus Features menu transition screen
5. Bonus Features screen
6. Audio Commentary screen
7. Commentary procedure screen
8. Audio Commentary introduction with Gonzo and Rizzo
9. 1991 Walt Disney Pictures logo
10. Jim Henson Productions logo
11. Start of film (with Audio Commentary enabled and with Brian Henson's voice commentary through the film)

That's all
youtube_title: Opening to Muppet Treasure Island 2002 DVD
